classification_rule: Smallest detected period in {1,2,4,8,16} whose retained tail repeats within absolute tolerance; otherwise unresolved/aperiodic.
refinement_rule: First adjacent coarse class change, followed by up to twelve deterministic binary probes. Refinement stops rather than relabeling a midpoint that reproduces neither stable endpoint class.
invalid_state_policy: Abort as invalid integration on NaN, infinity, overflow, dimension mismatch, or hard-state-limit breach.
